aboutThisItem: 1. Comfort-Focused Fabric Construction​​ These flowy wide-leg trousers are made from a lightweight polyester-blend fabric that offers​breathability and freedom of movement. The smooth texture minimises chafing for comfortable wear, while the airy drape ensures all-day comfort. For long-lasting quality, lay flat to dry in the shade after washing.

2. Adaptable Waistline Design Featuring an elevated waistline with an adjustable drawstring tie, this design allows personalized adjustments for a secure fit. Strategically tailored to balance​support and flexibility, the silhouette accommodates various body types while maintaining streamlined elegance.

3.Versatile Styling Options Transition effortlessly from casual outings to light fitness activities. Functional side pockets provide practical storage while preserving​the clean aesthetic. Ideal for weekend relaxation, travel essentials, or daily errands​​.

4. Precision Sizing Guidance​​ For the optimal fit, measure your natural waist, hip circumference, and inseam length (see detailed illustrations in the size chart). Our size chart lists measurements in both inches and centimeters​with tailored advice for different proportions.

5. Easy-Care Fabric Maintenance Machine wash in cold water with similar colors. Avoid harsh detergents and​bleach. To preserve​the tailored drape, reshape while damp and air-dry horizontally. Store folded or in a breathable garment bag to maintain shape​​.
